title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Procuratorate on the Application of Law to Acts of Forced Lending

articles.content_en:
Supreme People's Procuratorate
April 17, 2014
Supreme People's Procuratorate
Official Reply on Issues Concerning the Application of Law in Cases of Forced Lending
(Adopted at the 19th Session of the Twelfth Procuratorial Committee of the Supreme People's Procuratorate on April 11, 2014)
Gao Jian Fa Shi Zi [2014] No. 1
People's Procuratorate of Guangdong Province:
Your Request for Instructions on the Application of Law in Cases of Forced Lending (Yue Jian Fa Yan Zi [2014] No. 9) has been received. Upon review, the reply is as follows:
Forcing another person to lend or borrow by means of violence or coercion falls under the provision of "forcing another person to provide or accept services" as stipulated in Item 2 of Article 226 of the Criminal Law. If the circumstances are serious, criminal liability shall be investigated for the crime of forcing a transaction; if the act concurrently constitutes another crime such as the crime of intentional injury, the conviction and punishment shall be determined in accordance with the provisions on the heavier punishment. Where, for the purpose of illegal possession, a person obtains property of another person by means of violence or coercion under the pretext of lending, if the act meets the provisions of Article 263 or Article 274 of the Criminal Law, criminal liability shall be investigated for the crime of robbery or the crime of extortion.
This reply is hereby given.
Supreme People's Procuratorate
April 17, 2014
